description: Namada mainnet (namada.5f5de2dd1b88cba30586420). CometBFT RPC only (JSON-RPC and URI modes, websocket subscriptions); not a Cosmos SDK chain, so no REST or gRPC.

rpc_types.backend_hint: CometBFT RPC, default :26657 (JSON-RPC mode: POST / with a jsonrpc envelope)

specs.notes: Namada runs on CometBFT v0.37; covers JSON_RPC, COMET_BFT and /websocket on :26657. Namada state is read through abci_query, not Cosmos REST.

serving.backend: Namada full node (namadan ledger) with CometBFT RPC exposed on :26657.

healthcheck.notes: Chain-id assertion: guards against a node for a different network staked under this service id.

serving.notes: JSON_RPC here is CometBFT's JSON-RPC mode on the RPC port, the same server COMET_BFT addresses in URI style; websocket subscriptions are on that port at /websocket. Not Cosmos SDK: Namada runs its own ledger on CometBFT, so JSON_RPC (CometBFT) works but the Cosmos REST (:1317) and gRPC (:9090) servers do not exist; do not stake REST or GRPC for this service. No gateway health check configured yet.
